candidate.definition_en: The act of allowing someone to do something.
candidate.explanation_ar: الإذن أو السماح.. لما تطلب من حد يوافق إنك تعمل حاجة

senses.definition_en: The act of allowing someone to do something.
senses.explanation_ar: الإذن أو السماح بفعل شيء ما.
examples: You need permission to park here.
She gave me permission to use her car.
He entered the building without permission.
